stories.h: Overnight I-5 express lane, I-405 Kirkland closures this week
stories.s: Ship Canal Bridge express lanes close fully at 9 p.m. nightly through Wednesday, with southbound I-5 down to two lanes overnight. Northbound I-405 closes from NE 70th to NE 85th tonight, 11:59 p.m. to 5 a.m.

stories.h: King County committee rejects tax hikes for clinics, Harborview
stories.s: A County Council committee voted down Mosqueda proposals to raise property taxes for public health clinics and Harborview as Medicaid cuts take effect. It promised to consider the taxes next budget cycle. The full council votes Nov. 24.

stories.h: Metro pass sales, Lost and Found closed after building fire
stories.s: An electrical fire on Nov. 13 at King Street Center closed Metro's pass sales office and Lost and Found window until further notice. Riders can manage ORCA cards online at myorca.com or call 206-553-3000.

stories.h: Driver arrested after fatal hit-and-run in south Seattle
stories.s: A driver hit a man Sunday afternoon at MLK Jr. Way S and S Alaska St and drove away. The man later died at Harborview. Police found and arrested the driver.

stories.h: Two shot near Seattle's Magnuson Park
stories.s: A woman and a man were shot in the 6800 block of 62nd Ave NE in Sand Point. The man is in serious condition and the woman is stable. Seattle police are investigating.

coming.h: Seattle council's final vote on 2027-28 budget
coming.s: The full City Council plans to adopt the 2027-28 budget, which closes a $175M deficit. The Select Budget Committee takes its final vote Nov. 19.

coming.h: King County Council final supplemental budget vote
coming.s: The full council votes on the amended supplemental budget, including the committee's decision to put off property tax increases for public health and Harborview.
